<target>## **20.9. Single-Precision Floating-Point Classify Instruction**

The FCLASS.S instruction examines the value in floating-point register _rs1_ and writes to integer register _rd_ a 10-bit mask that indicates the class of the floating-point number. The format of the mask is described in Table 29. The corresponding bit in _rd_ will be set if the property is true and clear otherwise. All other bits in _rd_ are cleared. Note that exactly one bit in _rd_ will be set. FCLASS.S does not set the floating-point exception flags.

|31 / funct5|27 26 25 24 / fmt|20 / rs2|19 15 / rs1|14 12 11 / rm|7 / rd|6 0 / opcode|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|5|2|5|5|3|5|7|
|FCLASS|S|0|src|001|dest|OP-FP|

_Table 29. Format of result of FCLASS instruction._

|rd bit|Meaning|
|---|---|
|0|rs1 is .|
|1|rs1 is a negative normal number.|
|2|rs1 is a negative subnormal number.|
|3|rs1 is .|
|4|rs1 is .|
|5|rs1 is a positive subnormal number.|
|6|rs1 is a positive normal number.|
|7|rs1 is .|
|8|rs1 is a signaling NaN.|
|9|rs1 is a quiet NaN.|</target>
